elements.quote: Data synthesis: The meta-analysis was performed using the Review Manager 5.4 program with ORs as the effect measure. elements.quote: Our meta-analysis finds a significantly increased risk of inhospital mortality among hospitalized HF patients with sepsis/septic shock who received a restricted resuscitation strategy compared to those who met the 30 × 3 goal. This finding is consistent with that of Taenzer et al. and is aligned with the findings of other included research that, while not statistically significant, pointed in the same direction (Fig. 2).

elements.quote: All 4 included studies discussing the administration of 30 × 3 to HF patients with sepsis were retrospective and observational, therefore a risk of confounding and data limitation must be considered.
